home.intro: Music, economy, reminders and server tools. Manage the bot on your servers right from here.
home.title: Bot stats

servers.title: Servers
servers.subtitle: Servers where you can manage the bot
servers.emptyText: You need the Manage Server permission on a server to see it here.

members.resetMemberText: Money, bank, experience, level and transactions of this member on the server will be deleted.
members.resetEconomyTitle: Reset the economy of the whole server?

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.notAllowed: You or the bot don't have the permission or the role is too low

messages.textPlaceholder: Text, Discord markdown works: **bold**, # heading, -# small text

music.saveQueueText: The current track and the whole queue are added to the end of the playlist.

playlists.fileExpired: Deleted after 2 weeks without plays, upload it again or remove it
